text: The residents living on the north-south leg of Salonica Road have contacted my office about their concerns with the number of vehicles that park on both sides of the street to access the nearby Sunnybrook Park. In some cases, the volume of parked vehicles make it challenging for residents to enter and exit their driveways or drive down the street. They have submitted a petition to my office requesting for parking to be restricted on the east side of the street. Transportation staff have no concerns with the proposal.
North York Community Council: 1. Prohibited parking at all times on the east and north sides of Salonica Road, between the south end of Salonica Road and a point 150 metres north.
